headword: {居|い}ても{立|た}っても{居|い}られない
reading: いてもたってもいられない
gloss: unable to sit still; restless with anticipation or anxiety

definitions.gloss: unable to sit still; restless; too anxious or excited to stay put
definitions.explanation: Describes an intense emotional state where one cannot remain calm — whether from excitement, worry, anticipation, or impatience. Literally 'cannot stay whether sitting or standing.'

examples.japanese: {居|い}ても{立|た}っても{居|い}られなく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't sit still any longer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になって→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧、{居|い}ても{立|た}っても{居|い}られない。
examples.english: I'm so anxious about the results that I can't sit still.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧、{居|い}て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{居|い}られず、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけた→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: When I heard my friend was in danger, I couldn't sit still and rushed over immediately.

notes:
Literally 'cannot remain whether sitting ({居|い}て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧) or standing (⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧)' — expressing that no position is comfortable because of overwhelming emotion. A vivid idiom for intense restlessness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Often followed by a verb of action showing what the person did as a result of their restlessness:
- {居|い}て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{立|た}って→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{居|い}られず、〜⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ — unable to sit still, I did ~
- {居|い}ても{立|た}っても{居|い}られなく⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧ — becoming unable to sit still

COMMON TRIGGERS:
- Waiting for important results (exams, job applications)
- Hearing bad news about someone close
- Excitement before a major event
- Impatience when something is taking too long

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦じっとして→じっとする：25342_jittosuru⟧⟦いられない→いる：00495_iru⟧ — can't stay still (simpler, less emphatic)
- ⟦そわそわ→そわそわ：05267_sowasowa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be restless; fidgety (more about visible behavior)
- ⟦{気|き}が{気|き}でない→気が気でない：19540_kigakidenai⟧ — unable to focus due to worry
